description: Async regenerate/improve content. No instructions: full regen from brief (~2-5 min; poll get_content_status). With instructions: AI rewrite (~30-60s; check improvingStatus via get_content). Rewrites may change length - say 'maintain word count' to keep it.

brief_id.description: Brief to regenerate from (defaults to the content's linked brief).

instructions.description: AI-rewrite instructions (max 2000 chars). Omit to fully regenerate from brief. Add 'maintain word count' to preserve length.

name: regenerate_content
